entities.summary: David Martijn van Weel is a Dutch civil servant and diplomat who has served as Minister of Justice and Security since February 2026 in the Jetten cabinet, a role he previously held from July 2024 to September 2025 in the Schoof cabinet. Van Weel also served Minister of Foreign Affairs and of Asylum and Migration in the Schoof cabinet from September and June 2025, respectively, to February 2026.
